question: To reach point Q from point S, a person has to walk 83 m towards the west. He must then take a right turn and walk 240 m. He must take another right turn and walk 147 m. He must take another right turn and walk 240 m to reach the destination. How far and in which direction is point Q from point S? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
**Given**: To reach point Q from point S, a person has to walk 83 m towards the west. 

He must then take a right turn and walk 240 m. 

He must take another right turn and walk 147 m. 

He must take another right turn and walk 240 m to reach the destination

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a9bfb696691ccd8eb3a516dd68f92143c4b7d6d1d4add382556577ab9a86fe0.png] 

So,** point Q is 64m east from point S.**

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
